subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Should automatic daily and idle rollovers extend the existing reset-hook contract, or should OpenClaw define a distinct typed session-reset event for hook and plugin consumers?
rationale: The primary request adds a durable lifecycle API surface. The existing manual-reset hook behavior, third-party consumers, and archive timing make the permanent contract a maintainer product and compatibility decision rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Extend existing reset hooks
options.body: Dispatch the established internal reset and plugin pre-reset surfaces for automatic rollover with an explicit automatic reason, while preserving one delivery for manual resets.

options.title: Introduce a distinct reset event
options.body: Add a separately typed automatic session-reset event if maintainers want hook consumers to opt in without broadening command-reset semantics.

recommendation.title: Extend existing reset hooks
recommendation.body: Dispatch the established internal reset and plugin pre-reset surfaces for automatic rollover with an explicit automatic reason, while preserving one delivery for manual resets.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and the related implementation both place the decision in the hooks/plugins area.
